editor.label: Server message
editor.description: Shown to players in the lobby. Do not use the characters < > & or ".

editor.label: Players can download the server's mods from the server
Level difficulty (0-100)
editor.description: Mission and sandbox levels. The campaign sets its own difficulty.

editor.label: Start rounds automatically
editor.description: Starts a new round after the interval below when enough players are in the lobby.

editor.label: Hostname
editor.description: Up to 64 characters. Not allowed: double quotes, backslashes, < or &, line breaks.

editor.label: Private Password
editor.description: Up to 32 characters. Not allowed: double quotes, backslashes, < or &, line breaks.

configFiles.description: Server settings (serversettings.xml). Stop the server before editing: it saves this file when it stops.
configFiles.template:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<serversettings
  port="${GamePort}"
  queryport="${QueryPort}"
  password="${PrivatePassword}"
  ServerName="${Hostname}"
  ServerMessageText="${ServerMessage}"
  MaxPlayers="${Slots}"
  PlayStyle="${PlayStyle}"
  AllowModDownloads="${AllowModDownloads}"
  VoiceChatEnabled="${VoiceChatEnabled}"
  AllowVoteKick="${AllowVoteKick}"
  KarmaEnabled="${KarmaEnabled}"
  GameModeIdentifier="${GameMode}"
  RespawnMode="${RespawnMode}"
  SelectedLevelDifficulty="${LevelDifficulty}"
  BotCount="${BotCount}"
  AllowFriendlyFire="${AllowFriendlyFire}"
  AllowRewiring="${AllowRewiring}"
  AutoRestart="${AutoRestart}"
  AutoRestartInterval="${AutoRestartInterval}" />

script.name: Prepare the server
script.description: Creates the mods folder and config_player.xml. On Linux: puts steamclient.so where the Steam game server looks for it and installs GNU screen (the console) and missing libraries.

script.name: Add the Workshop mod to the server
script.description: Moves the downloaded content package to LocalMods/<id> and enables it in config_player.xml.

script.name: Remove the Workshop mod from the server
script.description: Disables the content package in config_player.xml and removes LocalMods/<id>.
